'''June 2001 Cedar Grove tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Cedar Grove, NJ on 23 June 2001. [[Michael Dalton]] won it. It is known from Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2520">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-25-cedar-grove-nj-23-jun-01d2520/ cedar-grove-nj-23-jun-01], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 25 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-25-cedar-grove-nj-23-jun-01d2520/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Cedar Grove, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Dalton]]
